title: Planet Coaster 2
shortDescription: Build and customise thrilling roller coasters and incredible water slides, manage the ultimate theme park experience, and share your epic creations. Are you ready to ride the wave?
zhShortDescription: 终极主题公园模拟器续作，建造水上乐园、设计过山车。
description: Create a splash with Planet Coaster 2 - sequel to the world’s best coaster park simulator! Reach new heights of creativity, management, and sharing as you construct the theme parks of your dreams combining epic water rides and coasters to delight and thrill your park guests. Dive in now! Expand your imagination: Enhanced and improved building and pathing tools let you create spectacular, true-to-life theme parks, complete with sprawling plazas. Make your mark on the world as you shape terrain and populate your park with stunning swimming pools and thrilling rides. It’s never been easier to bring your dream park to life. Create the ultimate theme park: Dive into a world of creativity with nine distinct themes, from returning classics like Pirate and Western, to exciting new additions in Vik
zhDescription: 《过山车之星2》是 Frontier 的终极主题公园模拟器续作。新增水上乐园元素——水上滑梯、造浪池、漂流河。建造系统极为自由，手动调整轨道每个节点。
metaDescriptionEn: Planet Coaster 2 review — ultimate theme park builder. Coaster design, guest satisfaction, profit optimization.
metaDescriptionZh: 《过山车之星2》Steam 评测与介绍 — 终极主题公园建造。轨道设计、游客满意度、盈利优化。

topReviews.review: As a minor player on Planet Coaster, I have not been playing very long although I've had the game awhile now I'm in my early 70's, My grandson built a new computer for me one that will play all the coaster games, I started off with Roller Coaster Tycoon years ago and got quite addicted I've progressed to Planet Coaster 2, I enjoy playing the game although I'm not very good and I persevere with it, I would highly recommend to anyone that like's platform games to think about buying it's fun and as I said very addictive
topReviews.zh_review: 作为过山车之星的轻度玩家，我玩得不久。我都70多岁了，孙子给我配了台能跑所有过山车游戏的新电脑。从过山车大亨年代一路玩到现在，已经上瘾了。虽然我玩得不太好但一直坚持。强烈推荐给喜欢这类游戏的人——有趣又上瘾。

topReviews.review: Having Played a little bit over the last 18 months or so since it launched i feel i can finally give Planet coaster 2 a review. where to start the game itself is a fantastic Builder game one of the best there is, you don't even have to build a theme park you can build pretty much anything you imagination can come up with. but coming from planet coaster 1 the change up was night an day being able to resize things an attach stuff to coasters and rides really where game changers. the addition of swimming pools and flumes was another plus. don't get me wrong the UI can be a bit of a headache at ti…
topReviews.zh_review: 玩了18个月后可以写评价了。游戏本身是顶级建造游戏——你甚至不需要做主题公园，可以建造任何想象的东西。相比一代，能调整大小、把物品附着到过山车上，是改变游戏规则的功能。游泳池和滑水道的加入是另一个加分项。UI有时让人头疼但整体很棒。

topReviews.review: I really wanted this to be good, so i waited with my review until i hopefully could give a positiv one. I can't... This game is so broken its not even funny! They break things with every update that worked before. It's really with every update. Then they release a quick hotfix for 4 or 5 of the problems a few day's later. Then its radio silent for 2-3 Months. When they have another DLC ready to press some money out of you, then they will also anounce a "fix" for the old ones. But it will only contain what is deemed necessary for Frontier. We have Bugs from the launch day's, that where never fi…
topReviews.zh_review: 我真的希望这游戏能好，一直等到能写好评……但我做不到。每次更新都破坏之前能用的功能。然后几天后发个热修复修4-5个问题。之后2-3个月静默。等DLC准备好榨钱时才宣布旧bug的'修复'。首发日bug至今没修。

topReviews.review:
Zu Planet Coaster 2 muss ich ehrlich sagen: Ich verstehe nicht ganz, warum es dafür unbedingt einen zweiten Teil gebraucht hat.

Klar, es sind einige neue Fahrgeschäfte dazugekommen, und grafisch wurde an manchen Stellen definitiv nachgebessert. Teilweise sieht das Spiel wirklich besser aus als der Vorgänger, das kann man nicht abstreiten. Trotzdem kommt bei mir persönlich leider kaum richtiger Spielspaß auf.

Vor allem einige der neuen Spielmechaniken sagen mir überhaupt nicht zu. Das ganze System mit Strom, Wasserfiltern und ähnlichen Verwaltungsaufgaben wird für meinen Geschmack auf Dauer e…
topReviews.zh_review: 关于过山车之星2我必须老实说：我不太明白为什么非要出第二代。画面确实提升了，不能否认。但对我来说真正的游戏乐趣几乎没有。整个电力、水过滤等管理系统太繁琐了。

topReviews.review:
I really don't like how there aren't built-in strtuctures for every theme, it feels really lazy and like they expect you to either want to build everything yourself or spend ages trying to browse for something you like in the workshop.

I just want to build a big theme park, I don't want to spend hours building structures.

It's great if you want that level of detail, but personally, I don't.
topReviews.zh_review: 我真的很不喜欢每个主题没有内置结构建筑——感觉特别懒，好像他们期望你要么自己从头建，要么花好几小时翻工坊。我只想建个大主题公园，不想花几个小时建结构。

whyPlay: Planet Coaster 2 is the best pure theme park builder available. The coaster builder is powerful enough that people spend hundreds of hours just designing rides. Water parks are a strong addition, and the graphical upgrade from PC1 is significant. The UI still has a learning curve, but once it clicks, there's nothing else like it.
whyPlayZh: 《过山车之星2》是最好的纯主题公园建造游戏。过山车编辑器强大到有人花几百小时只设计轨道。水上乐园是很棒的补充，画质比一代提升显著。UI 仍需学习但一旦上手，没有替代品。
